Replacing this line with packages: { digest: "constant", identified: true } is not distinguished by those tests or the check-run integration assertions.

explanation.what: The tests cover packages supplied directly to checkRequest/checkReusable, but not the new wiring from Melian's install into runChecks. Replacing this line with packages: { digest: "constant", identified: true } is not distinguished by those tests or the check-run integration assertions.
explanation.whatToDo: Add a runChecks integration test that changes the mocked Melian install digest between runs and asserts a new task, then repeats with identified false and the same digest and asserts no attachment.
explanation.whyHere: This is the point that makes an install change invalidate real check runs and prevents reuse on unidentified installs; unit tests with hand-built packages cannot guard it.

properties.failureScenario: With line 718 replaced by packages: { digest: "constant", identified: true }, run fast guardrails twice on the same revision, changing Melian's yaml install between calls: the second call reuses the first run. Likewise an unidentified Melian install can reuse it. check-request.test.ts still varies its own supplied packages, and check-requests.test.ts only compares stable requests and legacy code versions, so neither catches this wiring regression (inferred from assertions, not executed).
